<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_31bbb6-dc inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id35_be91d6-89 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_7e9e0b-6f inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h1 class="kt-adv-heading35_07404d-64 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading35_07404d-64">Studios Vrettos a Kitesurfer Paradise</h1>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-35_03d8d3-16"><div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center"><hr class="kt-divider"/></div></div>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id35_8fd062-93 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_9bf20d-79 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<figure class="wp-block-kadence-image kb-image35_9cc729-0d size-full kb-image-is-ratio-size"><div class="kb-is-ratio-image kb-image-ratio-port34"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="394" height="511" src="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Untitled_HDR-2-3-1.png" alt="untitled hdr 2 (3)" class="kb-img wp-image-177" srcset="https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Untitled_HDR-2-3-1.png 394w, https://studiosvrettos.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Untitled_HDR-2-3-1-231x300.png 231w" sizes="(max-width: 394px) 100vw, 394px" /></div></figure>
</div></div>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_82a1d2-31 inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col"><div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id35_641eb2-57 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_cd48ed-e6 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<p></p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Embrace the luxury of peace and seclusion at our beachfront hotel in Naxos at Plaka Beach, where you will not only find comfort and elegance but also the genuine warmth of Greek hospitality. Whether you are here for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a solo traveler, our hotel promises an unforgettable experience. Book your stay now and let the charm of the sea and the best of Greek hospitality make your Naxos vacation truly magical.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Escape the masses and noises from town and enjoy peaceful surroundings.</p>

<p class="has-text-align-center">Spoil yourself, sleeping close to nature and waking up with the noise of the Aegean Sea. Star gaze the night sky with a cocktail from our Rooftop Bar.</p>

<p></p>
</div></div>

</div></div></div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id35_5fa539-e4 alignnone wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-1-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-inherit kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-top">

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_ef6d3c-59 inner-column-1"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h3 class="kt-adv-heading35_e0b40d-5f wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading35_e0b40d-5f">We seek comfort with simplicity , charm and love for kitesurfing</h3>
</div></div>

</div></div>

<div class="kb-row-layout-wrap kb-row-layout-id35_9eda3b-5c alignnone has-theme-palette9-background-color kt-row-has-bg as-room wp-block-kadence-rowlayout"><div class="kt-row-column-wrap kt-has-2-columns kt-row-layout-equal kt-tab-layout-row kt-mobile-layout-row kt-row-valign-middle">

<h2 class="kt-adv-heading35_9296b4-45 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading35_9296b4-45">Garden View Studio</h2>

<p><em>Max 2 persons / ground floor / 30 sq.m</em></p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Queen size bed or 2 single beds</li>

<li>Private Balcony</li>

<li>Air condition</li>

<li>Mosquito net on request</li>

<li>Fully equipment kitchen</li>

<li>Breakfast included</li>
</ul>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-column kadence-column35_0c2230-5e inner-column-2"><div class="kt-inside-inner-col">
<h2 class="kt-adv-heading35_f95cd2-38 wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading35_f95cd2-38">Sea View Studio</h2>

<p><em><em>Max 2 persons / 1st floor / 30 sq.m</em></em></p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Queen size bed or 2 single beds</li>

<li>Private Balcony</li>

<li>Air condition</li>

<li>Mosquito net on request</li>

<li>Fully equipment kitchen</li>

<li>Breakfast included</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="kt-adv-heading35_e70f75-2e wp-block-kadence-advancedheading" data-kb-block="kb-adv-heading35_e70f75-2e">Sea View Apartment</h2>

<p><em>Max 5 persons / 1st floor floor / 60 sq.m</em></p>

<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Queen size bed , sofa bed &amp; single bed</li>

<li>Private Balcony</li>

<li>Air condition</li>

<li>Mosquito net on request</li>

<li>Fully equipment kitchen</li>

<li>Breakfast included</li>
</ul>
